body:
## Summary
- harden the clipboard E2E Android smoke parser to require the complete 8-method ClipboardManager instrumentation class, per-method pass records, raw instrumentation final code -1, and matching numtests
- add regression tests for legacy 5-test logs, stack-trace-only method names, failed raw methods, failed raw exit code, mismatched numtests, and serial sanitization
- refresh README/clipboard TEST docs and add a 2026-09-08 Nubia P0110 current-main blocked gate evidence bundle

## Gate status
- This does not close Android/macOS Clipboard product E2E.
- The final gate evidence remains blocked with gate_closed=false and can_close_android_macos_clipboard_e2e_gate=false.
- Android local ClipboardManager smoke passes using the retained 8/8 current-main log.
- Host readiness, USB readiness, trusted LAN readiness, and bidirectional product E2E evidence remain blocked/missing.

## Boundaries observed
- Did not start Vibe Screen/MacHost/Telemachus GUI.
- Did not run swift run.
- Did not request, reset, or modify Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, Keychain, TCC, or System Settings.
- Did not configure adb reverse tcp:54321 tcp:54321.

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_clipboard_e2e_gate -v
- cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityClipboardSystemBoundaryContractTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ClipboardApprovalStateTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.protocol.ProtocolV1ClipboardTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.protocol.ProtocolV1ClipboardFailClosedTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ClipboardPreviewPolicyTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.internet.InternetClipboardTest
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest tests.phase3.test_repository_privacy.RepositoryPrivacyTests.test_current_tree_has_no_raw_android_serial_contexts -v
- python3 scripts/phase3/evidence_privacy.py --evidence-dir docs/changes/2026-08-16-android-macos-clipboard/evidence/2026-09-08-nubia-p0110-clipboard-e2e-current-main-blocked --check
- git diff --check
- shasum -a 256 -c docs/changes/2026-08-16-android-macos-clipboard/evidence/2026-09-08-nubia-p0110-clipboard-e2e-current-main-blocked/SHA256SUMS
title: Harden clipboard E2E Android smoke gate
